description: Opens an order for a paid report and returns a Stripe Checkout URL (checkoutUrl) where the person, or you on their behalf, pays: Essential report €11 VAT included or Complete report with building condition €19 VAT included, VAT included, one-off payment, no subscription. Use it only when the person has decided to buy that report type. The complete report can only be bought when resolve_building says ieeAvailability=available. The building comes from resolve_building (resolutionToken, valid 15 minutes) or from a free report that is ready (freeReport with its jobId and statusToken; the paid report then reuses its sources). ACCEPTANCE: by calling it you accept, on the person's behalf, the consent text from get_products (data processing, immediate execution and loss of the right of withdrawal) and the Terms in force, including the clause on contracting through an agent; the person who delegates to you is bound by it, so tell them before calling. Pass consent=true with consent.statementSha256, termsVersion from get_products, acceptTerms=true and waiveWithdrawalRight=true. The email is required: receipt, report link and withdrawal confirmation go there. Nothing is generated until Stripe confirms the payment; then the report is ready in minutes (the AI summary follows) and the link is emailed. Poll get_report_status with the returned jobId and statusToken: awaiting_payment, payment_received, queued, in_progress, ready (or payment_expired, refunded, failed). Never publish the checkout or report link. Always tell the person: it is a preliminary, automated report built from public records, not a technical inspection, valuation, certificate, safety assessment or legal advice; probabilities are given as words (very low to very high), never as percentages; a check without data (○) means unknown, not negative or safe; Navarra is not covered yet; the report is only available as a private link.

acceptTerms.description: true: you accept the Terms, including the clause on contracting through an agent (consent.agentContractingTermsUrl).

consent.description: true: you accept the consent text from get_products on the person's behalf.

consentStatementSha256.description: consent.statementSha256 from get_products for the same language.

email.description: Email of the person (required): receipt, private report link and withdrawal confirmation.

freeReport.description: A ready free report of the same person to buy from: { jobId, statusToken } from create_free_report. Give this or resolutionToken, not both.

language.description: Language of the report, the checkout page and the texts: es, en, de, nl or fr. Default es. Must be the language of the consent text shown.

resolutionToken.description: resolutionToken returned by resolve_building (valid 15 minutes). Give this or freeReport, not both.

termsVersion.description: consent.termsVersion from get_products (the Terms version you accept).

tier.description: simple (essential report) or complete (only when the building has an IEE/ITE record).

waiveWithdrawalRight.description: true: the person asks for immediate execution and loses the 14-day right of withdrawal once the report is supplied.

name: purchase_report
title: Buy a paid HOUSINGFAX report (Stripe Checkout)
